venue.name: Univali - Univerdade do Vale do Itajaí

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MjEyNDgzLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--e88ce5718f2045f0e748da68cc0c5f3f442c3f38/WhatsApp%20Image%202026-09-02%20at%2015.56.14.jpeg) Bem-vindos ao CAU ao Cubo 2026, em Itajaí! Sua inscrição só será aprovada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba Inscrever. Se tiver dificuldades em se inscrever, veja como fazer neste [vídeo](https://youtu.be/wLE2OFf9nh8). Favor ler o [Regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição. Teremos premiação para todas as modalidades oficiais e premiação extra-oficial para o feminino, novatos, seniores e alunos do CAU na modalidade 'Cubo 3x3x3'. A premiação extra-oficial será feita de acordo com a classificação do competidor na competição. (não será definida apenas pela primeira rodada). A premiação extra-oficial dos alunos do CAU será feita de acordo com uma pontuação geral entre todas as modalidades, e será dividida entre Ensino Fundamental I, Ensino Fundamental II e Ensino Médio. Inscrições no local serão aceitas apenas para os eventos do segundo dia (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx e 3x3x3 OH). Por gentileza, esteja no local com no mínimo 1 hora de antecedência. 🇺🇸 Welcome to the CAU ao Cubo 2026, competition in Itajaí! Your registration will only be approved on the WCA website after payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the Register tab. If you have any difficulties with registration, take a look at this [video](https://youtu.be/4yo7IqbcgOA?si=SJNiCFCSh-eLN550). Please read the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition. We will have awards for all official events, as well as unofficial awards for women, beginners, seniors, and CAU students in the '3x3x3 Cube' event. The unofficial awards will be given according to the competitor's position in the competition (they will not be based solely on the first round results). The unofficial awards for CAU students will be based on an overall score across all events and will be divided into Elementary School I, Elementary School II, and High School. On-site registration will be accepted only for the events on the second day (3x3x3, 2x2x2, Pyraminx, and 3x3x3 One-Handed). Please arrive at the venue at least 1 hour in advance.

items.information: ## VOLUNTEERING Please note that all competitors are required to assist with volunteering during the competition - either in the role of "runner", "judge" or "scrambler". These roles will be explained as part of the "New Competitor Tutorial", but you can take a look at [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=8dSuMG--wm8). If any parents are willing to help judge or run, please watch the above video if you have not been a judge/runner at previous competitions. We greatly appreciate all assistance during the competition and more volunteers helping out during the competition helps to stay on schedule and not run behind. ## SPONSORSHIP ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTI5MTA0LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--8009ba06c22285cc1d3d3488d30eaedc709350c8/IMG_6226.png) A big thanks to [Cubestuff](https://cubestuff.co.za) who will co host this competition. They will have a stall set up at the venue for you to buy the different speedcubes they have on offer. You can also go to Cubestuff.co.za to order a variety of cubes and equipment online. follow them on socials by scanning the QR Code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjcwLCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--bea620be86f2f2e79b7ff56af3eef8d900240518/IMG_2596.jpg) The **Legacy Centurion Hotel** have gracouisly offered us the venue at a very reduced rate as part of their support for the competition. Please continue to return the favour to them by supporting their restaurant and accomodation. Also follow the hotel on socials by scanning the QR code below. ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTY2MjY1LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--781305c69b42fd5cad23e5a76d3b2c4c6e2cd2f3/IMG_2595.jpg) ##Accommodation The hotel have offered discounted accommodation rates to our cubers (and guests) for the weekend of the competition. You can book your accomodation by sending an email to Penny Mbobo pmbobo@legacyhotels.co.za and mention the code "Rubiks 2026" when making your booking. Reach out to the competition organizers or delegates if you have more questions. ## NOTICE FOR COMPETITORS Be sure to be ready to compete in any of your scheduled events at least 30 minutes before the scheduled starting time. ## About CubingZA CubingZA is a volunteer organisation made up of delegates and community members who have come together to try and ensure that we can sustainably run regular competitions all across the country. If you'd be interested in helping out in CubingZA's mission to improve competitive speedcubing in the country, please get in touch.

items.information: # 본 대회는 3x3x3 종목이 없습니다. # 멀티 블라인드: 전체 참가자 중 선착순 50%만 가능 # [참관객 제한](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit)이 존재합니다. WCA 공인 대회에 처음 참가 하신다면, 참가 신청 전에 [첫 참가자 안내](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) 탭과 [자주 묻는 질문](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) 탭을 확인하십시오. 모든 참가자는 [WCA 규정](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/)을 숙지하여야 합니다. WCA 규정 [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1e2)와 [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/korean/#1f2)에 따라, 모든 참가자는 운영진의 요청이 있을 시 스태프 업무를 수행해야 합니다. 원할한 기록 측정을 위하여 [대회 참가 안내 영상](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc)을 시청하여 주십시오. 원할한 스태프 업무 수행을 위하여 [스태프 규정 영상](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz)을 시청하여 주십시오. ___ # There is no 3x3x3 event at this competition. # MBLD: First 50% of registrants only. # There is a [Spectator Limit](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80103-spectator-limit). If this is your first official WCA competition, please read the [For New Competitors](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80100-for-new-competitors) tab and the [Frequently Asked Questions](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/TrickorBlindSeoul2026#80099-frequently-asked-questions) tab before registering. All competitors must be familiar with the [WCA Regulations](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/). Due to WCA Regulations [1e2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1e2) and [1f2](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/#1f2), all competitors are required to fulfill staff duties at the organizers' request. Please watch [this video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QfPqba-eKrc) to get familiar with WCA official competitions. Please watch [this video](https://youtu.be/3saR3HMi4JM?si=QdOG0tvo_5CvoDCz) to get familiar with staff duties.

items.information: ![](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/rails/active_storage/blobs/redirect/eyJfcmFpbHMiOnsiZGF0YSI6MTkxNDg3LCJwdXIiOiJibG9iX2lkIn19--767bdc8ab9ae35b6f1145b0e3ad61df3aed5a066/Logo%20Final%202.jpg) ## 🇧🇷 Português: Sua inscrição será confirmada no site da WCA após a confirmação do pagamento, que deverá ser efetuado de forma antecipada - mais informações na aba [Inscrição](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UNESPRioPretoOpen2026/register). Se estiver participando pela primeira vez, leia o [regulamento da WCA](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/translations/portuguese-brazilian/) antes da competição e aprenda a competir [assistindo o vídeo](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU). Não há idade mínima ou máxima para participação, mas competidores menores de 18 anos só podem participar com a presença de um responsável legal. Ao se inscrever, você autoriza que a ABRACM, WCA, UNESP, seus parceiros e apoiadores do campeonato utilizem a sua imagem nas fotos e filmagens que forem feitas no evento, de forma gratuita, inclusive para fins comerciais. ## 🇺🇸 English: 🇺🇸 **English:** Your registrarion will only be apporved on the WCA website after the payment confirmation, which must be made in advance - more information in the [Register](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/competitions/UNESPRioPretoOpen2025/register) tab. If this is your first time competing, read the [WCA Regulation](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/regulations/) before the competition and learn how to compete by watching this [video](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=UHqunxu3rOU). There is no minimum or maximum age for participation, but underage competitors can only participate with the presence of a legal guardian. By registering, you authorize ABRACM, WCA, UNESP and their partners to use your image in the photos and videos taken at the event, free of charge, including for commercial purposes.
